facts.text: Wollishofen was an independent municipality until 1893 when it joined Zürich.
The area lies between the Sihl river and Lake Zurich, forming the city's southern boundary on the lake's left bank.
The permanent exhibition 'Wollishofen, a journey through time' opened in 1985 and was redesigned in 2015, tracing history from pile dwellers to today.
The Hornerhaus farmhouse parlor in the museum houses a precious piece of Wollishofen's past.
The Zürichsee-Schifffahrtsgesellschaft shipyard is located in Wollishofen, linking the district to lake navigation.
The annual Zürcher Theater Spektakel festival takes place on the Landiwiese lakeshore and Saffa-Insel, making Wollishofen a cultural hotspot each August.
